author: gobernment
body:
I've come up with the following ideas, hopefully they can be added. These are my personal ideas and any support shown would be great so it can move forward. This might have more of a wishlist format too, and some of this might be already possible and testable.

- Free for All (Official support, one individual team with friendly fire, most kills wins)

[Original] - Blitz KoTH (You can only capture the hill once, and you win. Entire map turns that color.)

[Original] - Protect the President (Enemy has to kill President, then once President dies then there's a Vice President you have to kill. Vice president is revealed instantly once president dies, being a two-team game. The president and vice president have one life. I'm on a list now, probably. Hi NSA!)

[Original] - Condition Survival (You have two islands/sides, and they are not landlocked. You must use resources to go to the enemy's side and take them out. However, there are conditions to the game, one by default is a shrinking world border.

​There are two randomly picked conditions each time the match is picked. They can be:*
- Water is boiling hot (deadly to touch!)
- Every leaf drops a guaranteed apple
- Everyone gets night vision
- Everyone spawns with an iron pickaxe with efficiency
- TNT has a 2x larger blast radius upon use
- Grass can be eaten as an easy food source (will turn to dirt!)
- Torches will burn out and be replaced with redstone torches
- All ores will yield an extra of its own kind
- Random chests will be placed as supply drops
- Natural regeneration is off
- Mobs are forbidden to spawn

More can be added as time goes on but it's an alternative for walls players and keeps it pvp oriented.)

[Original] - Elektro (You have to do melee attacks via swinging your sword on an Elektro (Endercrystal) in order to deteriorate it, bringing it to 0. When all of the Elektro are eliminated, the game ends with the team who broke it the most. The Elektro is in the middle of the map, and you have to fight the enemy team over which gets more hits to it.)

[Original] - Grab and Run (CTW and DTM mix. Break the obsidian, and run back to place it in your base once grabbed. If the monument is not placed within a certain amount of time, the obsidian regenerates. This should be a two-team game at maximum and use up to only three per side.) [Credit to Cyclops for initial idea]

- Sky Wars (Classic Sky Wars. Can be done easily with a one life module.)

[Original] - UHC KoTH/TDM (A crossover like this hasn't quite been made yet, Avicus can jump onto this. A cross between having no natural regeneration and providing raw materials through the map to recover health and make your own combat style, but at the same time with an objective via capturing a hill somewhere in the generation.)

Thoughts?
